description: [forged] Fetches a World Bank development indicator value for a given country and year via https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/<iso>/indicator/<indicator>?format=json. Returns the country name, indicator name, year and numeric value (or null if unavailable). (costs $0.003 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code, e.g. US or USA

indicator.description: World Bank indicator code, e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD or SP.POP.TOTL

name: worldbank_indicator
